subject: Milestone checklist & pricing safeguard questions
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@starlake.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:23:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Initial MAP thoughts + evaluation window

Diego —

Thanks for the demo earlier. Starlake's leadership is aligned to run a 60-day evaluation, but procurement/legal surfaced a couple of commercial items we need clarified before we can commit to milestones:

- True-up mechanics: how will over/under usage be reconciled at the end of each milestone?
- Price protection: can you guarantee a fixed per-token price for the initial 3 months of the MAP?
- Definitions: we need a clear definition of what counts as billable usage (inference tokens, fine-tuning, embeddings, or any retrain calls?)

We want to avoid open-ended language that triggers finance hold-ups. If you can share a short MAP checklist and how you typically handle ramp/credits for under-utilization, that will help speed internal approvals.

Goal: have commercial terms agreed so we can sign a pilot commitment by mid-December.

Best,
Jordan
Director of AI Platforms
Starlake AI


From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@starlake.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:06:00 -0800
Subject: Milestone checklist & draft MAP attached

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear asks. Attaching a one-page MAP and a checklist that maps milestones to billing mechanics (attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf, MAP_Checklist.xlsx). High level:

- Eval window: 60 days with three milestones at day 15 / day 30 / day 60.
- Commits & ramp: customer commits to an initial monthly committed spend (month 1 = 25% of projected usage, month 2 = 50%, month 3 = 100% target), with a 30-day ramp tolerance.
- True-up: usage above committed is billed at the agreed rate; usage below committed flows into a single true-up at the end of the MAP quarter with the option to carry forward up to 20% of unused committed units into the subsequent month (one-time rollover).
- Price protection: we can guarantee the quoted per-token price for 90 days from execution for pilot customers; after that the standard price change clause applies with 30-day notice.
- Billable usage definition: inference generation tokens and embeddings only; fine-tuning and hosted model training are out-of-scope for this MAP and billed separately.

If procurement needs stricter guarantees (e.g., 180-day price lock or different true-up mechanics) let me know — I can loop finance/legal. For now the MAP attached is our recommended starting point.

Next steps: 1) review redlines from procurement/legal, 2) agree final commit and price protection term, 3) sign pilot SOW.

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP summary), MAP_Checklist.xlsx (milestone-to-billing mapping)


From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Milestone checklist & draft MAP attached

Diego —

Quick read through the MAP. Thinking aloud on commercial posture: we should be prepared to offer a 90-day price protection (as you proposed) but push back on full rollover of unused committed units beyond a one-time 20% carry — finance won't accept indefinite rollovers. Alternatives:

- Offer credits for under-utilization equal to 10% of the committed spend for month 1 only (to reduce churn risk).
- For true-up, prefer monthly reconciliation rather than a single quarterly true-up (gives us better cashflow predictability).

Neha — can legal/finance accept a monthly true-up with the 20% one-time carry and a 90-day price protection window? If not, what are the realistic boundaries we can offer without impacting unit economics?

Marissa
Head of Sales, Enterprise

From: Lily Zhang <lily.z@starlake.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@starlake.ai
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 15:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Milestone checklist & pricing safeguard questions

Diego / Marissa —

Thanks for the MAP packet. Procurement has reviewed and uploaded a marked-up redline (attached: Starlake_Redlines_v2.docx). Summary of our primary redlines and asks:

1) True-up cadence: we cannot agree to a single quarterly true-up. We need per-month reconciliation with a 30-day invoice cycle.
2) Price protection: 180-day fixed rate requested — shorter windows are difficult for budgeting.
3) Definitions: please confirm that embeddings and batched inference for offline features are counted as billable usage; we do not expect fine-tuning/API retrain charges to be included.
4) Rollover: request ability to carry forward any unused committed units for up to two months (not just one-time).

We flagged a few language clarifications where ambiguity could create unexpected charges (examples in the doc). Our legal also suggested clarifying a price-protection carveout if there is a force majeure or major cloud provider cost shock.

If you can share a response matrix to each redline, we can fast-track this. Our objective remains the same: sign pilot SOW by mid-December.

Best,
Lily Zhang
Senior Procurement Manager, Starlake AI

Attachments: Starlake_Redlines_v2.docx

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Proposed concessions and next steps for Starlake MAP (need sign-off)

Team —

Following procurement's redlines (attached), recommended stance to keep deal economics intact while moving toward signature:

1) True-up cadence: accept monthly reconciliation with invoicing net-30, but preserve our right to apply an overage rate that steps up slightly (5%) if they exceed committed usage by >150% in any month — protects unit economics.
2) Price protection: counter with 120-day fixed rate (compromise between our 90-day and their 180-day ask).
3) Definitions: clarifying language that embeddings + online inference are billable; explicit exclusion for fine-tuning/training. Add examples in the MAP checklist.
4) Rollover: accept up to two-month carry but cap cumulative rollover at 25% of committed units across the pilot.

If legal is OK with the stepped-overage protection and the 120-day price lock, I recommend we accept the redlines and prepare the SOW for signatures. I can upload a revised MAP and send for DocuSign (proposed envelope: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/XYZ-987). HubSpot deal updated here: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567 (RDW-2391).

Please reply with APPROVE / REJECT / NEEDS_EDIT. If I don't hear back by EOD tomorrow, I'll assume APPROVE and proceed to finalize the SOW for signature.

Thanks,
Diego
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Starlake_Redlines_v2.docx (for reference)
